title: Kazakh body and well-being lexicon: 83 health topics, search keywords and WHO-5 wording in Kazakh, Russian and English
description: Parallel lexicon of 83 women's health topics with names, life themes and 1,913 search keywords in Kazakh, Russian and English, plus WHO-5 Well-Being Index wording. Built from the women's psychosomatics section of 108psy.com.
